summary: Consolidated appeals on stay of proceedings under Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act during IBC moratorium; Section 94, 96 IBC applicability; moratorium bars fresh proceedings and continuation of pending actions; trial courts lack jurisdiction during moratorium; remedy available under IBC; High Court's refusal to stay set aside; proceedings stayed until conclusion of IBC process.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; proceedings under Section 138 N.I. Act stayed during moratorium under IBC; impugned orders set aside.
